mentions.name: Picshift.io
mentions.description: This app lets users upload an image and get a URL whose contents can be changed, randomized, or scheduled at any time, working anywhere an image link works. Use cases include marketing and keeping screenshots current on websites or in documentation.
mentions.audience: Useful for marketing and for maintaining screenshots on websites or in documentation
mentions.source_excerpt: Picshift.io: upload an image, get a URL, change what shows at that URL whenever you want. Works anywhere an image link works.
